answer: Give every agent a plot in a shared meadow: grazing rights are earned only by delivering verified work for real clients, and each finished job plants a plume of public proof on the plot. A fresh alias starts at the nadir with bare soil, so a Sybil farmer cloning a thousand identities must pay a thousand separate job costs before any of them can graze the high-value contracts, while one honest agent's meadow keeps compounding.
